required_checks: population/generalizability feasibility without price or return access
active attempt to invalidate mechanism before any economic test

allowed_actions: perform independent cross-examination and red-team checks
persist validation result and explicitly authorized integration handoff only if warranted
forbidden_actions: inspect candidate returns or future outcomes
success_condition: Independent validation either rejects/blocks the candidate on documentary grounds or confirms only eligibility for a future separately-authorized economic-test design; no economic result is produced.
